volumeInfo.title: La verdad sobre el caso Harry Quebert
volumeInfo.description: August 30, 1975: the day fifteen-year-old Nola Kellergan is seen being chased through the woods before disappearing from the small town of Aurora, New Hampshire. Thirty-three years later, Marcus Goldman, a successful young novelist, visits Aurora to stay with his mentor, Harry Quebert, only to learn that Harry has been having an affair with Nola.

volumeInfo.title: El enigma de la habitación 622
volumeInfo.description: A high-stakes thriller involving a murder in a luxury Swiss hotel and a financial conspiracy. A novelist stays at the Palace de Verbier in the Swiss Alps, where he becomes intrigued by a murder that occurred years earlier in room 622.

volumeInfo.title: El Libro de los Baltimore
volumeInfo.description: Two cousins from different branches of the Goldman family face a tragedy that changes everything. Until the day of the Tragedy, there were two Goldman families: the Goldmans of Baltimore and the Goldmans of Montclair.
